sources.title: EU lawmakers send Mercosur trade deal to top court

stances_toward.note: Association agreement and interim trade agreement signed on 17 Jan 2026; Parliament sent the texts to the Court of Justice on 21 Jan (334-324); the Commission went ahead and the interim trade agreement has applied provisionally since 1 May 2026 with Argentina and Uruguay (ratified 26 Feb); Poland has asked the Court to annul the Council decision (C-460/26 R, order of 29 Sep 2026). France, Poland and farmers resist; Germany, Spain and, after a one-month delay, Italy pushed. Warming despite the fight.
